items.html: And Kuf-Samekh-Alef (KaSA), which is the aspect of the front (Panim) of the Name Eheyeh of Yudin that is in Ima, as is known. And behold, according to this, what our sages said is difficult — that Adam himself is the Challah of the world, and if so, he himself was fit to take all the hundred and twenty cubits. And the answer is in what is known in the verse "Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?" (Efo hayita be-yasdi aretz), as is mentioned in Midrash Rabbah and in Tanchuma, whose language is: "This teaches that Adam HaRishon was lying as a shapeless mass (Golem), etc., and all the souls — one hung from his head, one from his neck, and one from his eyes, etc."
